D CORE LC/UPC Male to SC/UPC Female Hybrid Fiber Adapter

The D CORE LC/UPC Male to SC/UPC Female Hybrid Fiber Adapter is a high-quality fiber optic adapter designed to provide a seamless connection between LC and SC connectors in simplex mode. This hybrid adapter is an essential component for fiber optic networks, allowing for efficient and stable data transmission while maintaining low insertion loss. Designed for single-mode OS2 9/125μm fiber, this adapter ensures superior optical performance with an insertion loss of ≤0.5dB, minimizing signal degradation. It is ideal for use in telecommunication systems, data centers, fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) applications, and testing environments where LC to SC fiber connections are required. The D CORE LC to SC Hybrid Adapter is built with durable plastic and metal materials, ensuring long-lasting performance and reliability. With a flame resistance rating of UL 94V-0, it meets high safety standards, making it suitable for demanding applications. Additionally, it is designed for high durability, supporting up to 1,000 connection cycles without performance loss. Capable of operating in a wide temperature range (-25°C to 70°C), this adapter is suitable for both indoor and controlled outdoor environments. Its compact and lightweight design makes it easy to install, while the secure connection ensures a stable fiber link for critical network applications. This LC/UPC Male to SC/UPC Female Hybrid Fiber Adapter is an efficient, cost-effective solution for technicians, engineers, and network operators looking to integrate LC and SC fiber optic devices. Whether used for fiber splicing, network expansion, or testing purposes, it guarantees high-performance optical connectivity with minimal signal loss and maximum durability.

Features of D CORE LC/UPC Male to SC/UPC Female Hybrid Fiber Adapter

  • Simplex Design – Designed for simplex fiber connections, ensuring efficient and reliable data transmission.
  • LC Male to SC Female Connector – Allows seamless connection between LC and SC connectors, ideal for various fiber network applications.
  • Low Insertion Loss – Provides ≤0.5dB insertion loss, minimizing signal attenuation for optimal performance.
  • Durability – Built for long-lasting use, supporting up to 1,000 connection cycles without degradation.
  • OS2 9/125μm Fiber Mode – Designed for single-mode fiber networks, providing precise and stable signal transmission.
  • Wide Temperature Range – Operates efficiently in a temperature range of -25°C to 70°C, making it suitable for indoor and controlled outdoor environments.
  • Flammability Rating UL 94V-0 – The adapter is made from flame-retardant materials, ensuring safety in demanding environments.
  • Plastic & Metal Construction – Durable and high-quality materials, ensuring strong performance and reliable connections.
  • Compact & Lightweight – Easy to install and integrate into fiber optic networks with minimal space requirements.
